/loop 30m Start the "Client Docs to Forms" loop.

Goal: every open case has an approved master record and completed output forms ready for delivery or explicit escalation
Max iterations: 20
Between iterations run: Report open cases, pending extractions, low-confidence fields, master records awaiting sign-off, and unfilled output forms
Exit when: zero open cases without approved master record or explicit escalation, all low-confidence fields reviewed, and pending forms have owner or human approval

Step 1 — Intake: Collect client documents from portal, email, or uploads; track new cases.
Step 2 — Extract: AI reads documents with per-field confidence scores; flag low-confidence extractions.
Step 3 — Master record: Merge extracted fields into one record; resolve conflicts across source docs.
Step 4 — Review: Route judgment calls to team sign-off before anything is final.
Step 5 — Forms: Populate firm-specific output forms from approved master record with full audit trail.

loops.title: Customer Activity on Autopilot
loops.description: Aggregate every customer interaction into a structured activity graph — emails, meetings, notes, calls, and webhooks from team and agents. Extract the right next actions, queue tracked tasks for reps and MCP clients, execute from anywhere, and keep CRM, email, and calendar in sync so nothing falls through the cracks.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: activity graph is current, next actions are queued or executed, and open commitments have owners with full audit trail
loops.checkCommand: Report unsynced activity sources, accounts with stale activity, open next actions without owners, and pending CRM sync backlog
loops.exitCondition: activity graph covers all connected sources, every open commitment has a tracked task or explicit escalation, and high-impact CRM changes are approved or queued
guardrails: Do not auto-send customer-facing emails or messages without human approval unless pre-approved templates apply
Preserve full account context when creating tasks — link back to source activity
Do not overwrite CRM fields without explicit approval for high-impact changes (deal stage, amount, owner)
Escalate ambiguous next actions to human rep rather than guessing
API and MCP actions must be auditable with actor (human vs agent) recorded

loops.title: Production Security on Autopilot
loops.description: A fleet of specialized security agents across your entire stack — pentesting, internal discovery, and remediation grounded in a live production knowledge graph. Agents run on every PR, deployment, and alert, catch threats in seconds, and verify fixes before closing.
loops.author: Trooper
loops.goal: open findings triaged with graph context, critical issues escalated, and verified fixes landed in production
loops.checkCommand: Report open findings by severity, unverified fixes, stale graph assets, and unprocessed PR/deploy/alert events
loops.exitCondition: zero critical or high findings without owner and remediation plan, every resolved finding has verified fix in production, and live graph covers all connected stack sources
guardrails: Use read-only roles for discovery and graph building unless explicitly approved for remediation
Do not apply destructive changes in production without human approval
Escalate critical and zero-day findings immediately — do not wait for the next loop iteration
Never expose secrets, tokens, or credentials in logs or reports
Mark findings resolved only after verified fix — not just PR merged
Preserve audit trail linking finding → fix → verification event

flow.exitLabel: Findings owned, verified, or escalated; graph current
